claims.text: A 32-year-old man with hypertension and a family history of psoriasis in both grandmothers presented to dermatology clinic with linear erythematous scaly plaques along the lines of Blaschko of the back, right arm and right thigh present for over 23 years, plus a discrete silver-scaled plaque on the left elbow, without joint pain or joint, scalp or nail involvement. He was a nonsmoker.
